lumen_robotaxi_call.title: Lumen Robotaxi: call a Lumen
lumen_robotaxi_call.desc: Send the nearest Lumen robotaxi to your location

lumen_robotaxi_board.title: Lumen Robotaxi: board / exit
lumen_robotaxi_board.desc: Get into your Lumen when it has arrived, or get out at the destination

lumen_robotaxi_pullover.title: Lumen Robotaxi: pull over / continue
lumen_robotaxi_pullover.desc: Pull over at the next safe spot, or continue the trip after pulling over

lumen_robotaxi_lidar.title: Lumen Robotaxi: lidar view
lumen_robotaxi_lidar.desc: Show what the Lumen's lidar sees, colored by what it hits

lumen_robotaxi_brain.title: Lumen Robotaxi: switch Lumen Drive / Lumen NN
lumen_robotaxi_brain.desc: Switch the fleet between the rule-based driver (Lumen Drive) and the neural-network driver (Lumen NN). Not bound by default: N is the headlights.
